sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Basel-Stadt)

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: The canton, on real estate of legal entities (Grundstücksteuer)

rows.label: Rate (share of the taxable property value)
Credit
rows.value: Credited against the profit and capital taxes of the same tax period, so it works as a minimum tax

rows.label: Exempt
rows.value: Among others, property mainly used for the owner's own business

source.title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Basel-Stadt)

rows.label: Reduced rate for owner-occupied homes (acquisition of a home occupied for at least 6 years, or reinvestment in a replacement home in the canton)
Who pays
rows.value: The acquirer, unless the law says otherwise

source.title: Basel-Stadt Gesetz über die Handänderungssteuer (SG 650.100), Stand 1. Juli 2014

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
